0 grammar ::= remember stmtseq
1 grammar ::= GRAMEXPR optexpr
2 grammar ::= GRAMBLOCK block
3 grammar ::= GRAMBARESTMT barestmt
4 grammar ::= GRAMFULLSTMT fullstmt
5 grammar ::= GRAMSTMTSEQ stmtseq
6 grammar ::= GRAMSUBSIGNATURE subsigguts
7 bare_statement_block ::= block cont
8 bare_statement_expression ::= sideff PERLY_SEMICOLON
9 bare_statement_null ::= PERLY_SEMICOLON
10 bare_statement_utilize ::= KW_USE_or_NO startsub BAREWORD optlistexpr PERLY_SEMICOLON
11 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
12 empty ::=
13 remember ::=
14 stmtseq ::= empty
15 stmtseq ::= stmtseq fullstmt
16 fullstmt ::= barestmt
17 barestmt ::= bare_statement_block
18 barestmt ::= bare_statement_expression
19 barestmt ::= bare_statement_null
20 barestmt ::= bare_statement_utilize
21 sideff ::= expr
22 cont ::= empty
23 startsub ::=
24 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs
25 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs COLONATTR
26 attr ::= ATTRLIST
27 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
28 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
29 attrs ::= empty
30 attrs ::= attrs COLONATTR attr
31 attrs ::= attrs attr
32 attrlist ::= COLONATTR
33 optsiglist ::= empty
34 subsigguts ::= optsiglist
35 expr ::= listexpr
36 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA
37 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA term
38 listexpr ::= term
39 termbinop ::= term ASSIGNOP term
40 termbinop ::= term ADDOP term
41 termbinop ::= termrelop
42 termbinop ::= termeqop
43 termrelop ::= relopchain
44 termrelop ::= term NCRELOP term
45 termrelop ::= term PLUGIN_REL_OP term
46 relopchain ::= term CHRELOP term
47 relopchain ::= relopchain CHRELOP term
48 termeqop ::= eqopchain
49 termeqop ::= term NCEQOP term
50 eqopchain ::= term CHEQOP term
51 eqopchain ::= eqopchain CHEQOP term
52 termunop ::= PERLY_MINUS term
53 termunop ::= PERLY_PLUS term
54 termunop ::= PERLY_EXCLAMATION_MARK term
55 termunop ::= PERLY_TILDE term
56 termunop ::= term POSTINC
57 termunop ::= term POSTDEC
58 termunop ::= PREINC term
59 termunop ::= PREDEC term
60 term ::= termbinop
61 term ::= termunop
62 term ::= myattrterm
63 term ::= scalar
64 term ::= star
65 term ::= hsh
66 term ::= ary
67 term ::= arylen
68 term ::= THING
69 term ::= amper
70 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm attrlist
71 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm
72 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN myterm attrlist
73 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN term
74 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN expr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
75 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
76 myterm ::= scalar
77 myterm ::= hsh
78 myterm ::= ary
79 optlistexpr ::= empty
80 optlistexpr ::= listexpr
81 optexpr ::= empty
82 optexpr ::= expr
83 amper ::= PERLY_AMPERSAND BAREWORD
84 scalar ::= PERLY_DOLLAR
85 ary ::= PERLY_SNAIL
86 hsh ::= PERLY_PERCENT_SIGN
87 arylen ::= DOLSHARP
88 star ::= PERLY_STAR BAREWORD
